name: Ichigaya Kokoro
source:
Protagonist's little sister.
Removing her "personality", a flawless girl.
Jeers on the protagonist, her older brother without hesitation and pushes him around to do stuff for her.
However, it is her way of expressing love.

"Idiot Onii-chan... Don't look here!!"
